title: 5 Experiences when traveling to Mekong
excerpt: Mekong welcomes visitors with famous landscapes, coming here visitors will experience the natural beauty and participate in exciting games such as: mountain hiking, river rafting, kayaking, scuba diving, windsurfing… Mekong Ecotourism Area
html:
Mekong welcomes visitors with famous landscapes, coming here visitors will experience the natural beauty and participate in exciting games such as: mountain hiking, river rafting, kayaking, scuba diving, windsurfing…

Mekong Ecotourism Area

If you have the opportunity to travel to Mekong, visitors should visit the ecotourism area to experience attractive services such as: mountain hiking, river rafting, kayaking, scuba diving, windsurfing… which will bring visitors a feeling of excitement.

In addition, visitors can also watch the sunrise at Phu Chi Fa, picnic on the clear Kuang Si waterfall, and take a boat on the Mekong River which will bring visitors a feeling of excitement.

If you travel to the West – Mekong, visit the U Minh Ha forest and admire the fresh nature, visit the Xeo Quyt resistance base (Dong Thap) while wandering through the forest and enjoying the delicious dishes of the river region.

Island tourism

When talking about islands, you probably think of Phu Quoc, Da Nang, Con Dao … but few people know that when coming to the Mekong, visitors will experience going by boat through the rivers, the green coconut trees … will bring visitors a feeling of excitement.

Agricultural tourism

Visitors will visit the peaceful rustic villages, experience the life of the people here, especially when traveling to the Mekong, visitors can also experience the garden house, which is a choice loved by many foreign tourists, with the gentle and hospitable people.

Spiritual tourism

Many tourists often choose spiritual tourism in early spring, often go to meditation areas, visit temples to pray for a year of good health and peace.

In the Mekong, there are many spiritual tourist areas, or pilgrimages through pagodas. When talking about the West, we must mention Vinh Trang Pagoda (Tien Giang), Xiem Can Pagoda (Bac Lieu), Kh’leang Pagoda (Soc Trang), Bat Pagoda (Soc Trang)…

Cultural and artistic tourism

This is a hot topic that many tourists are interested in, with visiting areas displaying artists’ studios, museums, ancient cultural heritages… are attractive destinations for tourists.

In addition, when you have enjoyed the sightseeing, it is also time for tourists to enjoy Western cuisine, or participate in cooking by preparing regional dishes with the chef.

It can be said that the Mekong will bring visitors exciting experiences, especially traveling on boats on the Mekong River or participating in floating markets and enjoying delicious and attractive dishes such as: Banh xeo, hot pot with fish sauce, Long Xuyen durian salad, My Tho noodles…
